candidate.educational_objective: Recognize the duration and worry pattern characteristic of generalized anxiety disorder.

options.A: Excessive, difficult-to-control worry on most days for at least 6 months
options.B: A single brief episode of fear lasting several minutes with no ongoing worry
options.C: Fear limited only to one specific object or situation
options.D: Elevated mood with decreased need for sleep and increased goal-directed activity

candidate.rationale: NIMH states that GAD involves excessive worry that is difficult to control on most days for at least 6 months, with associated symptoms such as restlessness, fatigue, concentration difficulty, irritability, muscle tension, or sleep problems.
candidate.source_claim_supported: GAD diagnosis requires difficulty controlling worry on most days for at least 6 months plus associated symptoms.
candidate.source_document_title: Generalized Anxiety Disorder: What You Need to Know
candidate.source_locator: How is generalized anxiety disorder diagnosed?
candidate.stem: Which finding is most consistent with generalized anxiety disorder (GAD)?
